build_BinauralNetwork: build a binaural speech synthesis network that warps mono audio into binaural output using view tensors
create_Warpnet: create a Warpnet module that combines geometric and neural warpfields to warp mono signals into binaural audio
create_HyperConvWavenet: create a HyperConvWavenet that processes audio signals through hypernetwork-conditioned convolutional blocks with skip connections
review_GeometricWarper: review the GeometricWarper class that computes 3D displacements between transmitter mouth and receiver ears for audio warping
